Instances.desc: Volcanic caverns beneath Orgrimmar, where troggs and the Burning Blade cult plot against the Horde from the shadows.
Instances.name: Ragefire Chasm
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Dark Iron intruders have broken into the royal tombs of the ancient dwarven thanes beneath Old Ironforge, and the restless dead have awoken.
Instances.name: Hall of Thanes
Instances.statusText: New Forever dungeon. Loot confirmed in the beta.

Instances.desc: The Scourge still hold the ruined capital above the Undercity, where a necromancer gathers power among the ashes of Lordaeron.
Instances.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
Instances.statusText: New Forever dungeon. Loot confirmed in the beta.

Instances.desc: Beneath the abandoned mines of Moonbrook, Edwin VanCleef's Defias Brotherhood is building a juggernaut to strike at Stormwind.
Instances.name: The Deadmines
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Deep beneath the Barrens, the Druids of the Fang guard the dreaming Naralex, whose nightmare has twisted the caverns and everything in them.
Instances.name: Wailing Caverns
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Archmage Arugal and his worgen hold the keep above Pyrewood Village, where the curse of Shadowfang keeps spreading.
Instances.name: Shadowfang Keep
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: A flooded night elf temple on the Zoram Strand, now held by naga, satyrs and the Twilight's Hammer in the service of Aku'mai.
Instances.name: Blackfathom Deeps
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Stormwind's prison has fallen into chaos: Defias inmates led by Bazil Thredd have seized the cell blocks.
Instances.name: The Stockade
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: An Explorers' League dig broke into ancient Titan halls: strange mist, flashes of light and constructs that still stand guard.
Instances.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
Instances.statusText: New Forever dungeon. Loot confirmed in the beta.

Instances.desc: With the Kirin Tor's barrier failing, the violet city is overrun by rogue enchantments, arcane constructs and leaking demonic energy.
Instances.name: City of Dalaran
Instances.statusText: New Forever dungeon. Loot confirmed in the beta.

Instances.desc: The gnomes' irradiated capital, lost to the troggs and the treachery of Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
Instances.name: Gnomeregan
Instances.statusText: Loot partly confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: A thorny labyrinth in the southern Barrens, home of the quilboar and their death's-head priestess Charlga Razorflank.
Instances.name: Razorfen Kraul
Instances.statusText: Loot confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Restless crusaders haunt the monastery's graveyard, where Bloodmage Thalnos still lingers.
Instances.name: Scarlet Monastery: Graveyard
Instances.statusText: Loot partly confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: Houndmaster Loksey and Arcanist Doan guard the Scarlet Crusade's forbidden tomes.
Instances.name: Scarlet Monastery: Library
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table with the new Forever items known so far. No drops recorded yet.

Instances.desc: Sunken troll ruins have risen from the sea off Stranglethorn Vale, and trolls, naga and pirates fight over what lies within.
Instances.name: The Drowned City
Instances.statusText: Boss names from the BlizzCon demo. Loot revealed at launch.

Instances.desc: Herod, the Scarlet Champion, stands watch over the Crusade's arsenal.
Instances.name: Scarlet Monastery: Armory
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; Forever changes not recorded yet.

Instances.desc: The quilboar's ancestral burial grounds have fallen to the Scourge, led by the lich Amnennar the Coldbringer.
Instances.name: Razorfen Downs
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; Forever changes not recorded yet.

Instances.desc: At the heart of the monastery, Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane lead the zealots.
Instances.name: Scarlet Monastery: Cathedral
Instances.statusText: Loot partly confirmed in the Forever beta.

Instances.desc: An enormous ogre stronghold whose raiders take prisoners, and whose night-time chanting hints at the Twilight's Hammer.
Instances.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
Instances.statusText: Announced for launch. Bosses and loot not revealed yet.

Instances.desc: An ancient Titan vault in the Badlands, contested by Dark Iron dwarves, troggs and the stone watcher Archaedas.
Instances.name: Uldaman
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; Forever changes not recorded yet.

Instances.desc: The sun-baked troll city of the Sandfury in Tanaris, ruled by Chief Ukorz Sandscalp.
Instances.name: Zul'Farrak
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: A sacred centaur cavern in Desolace, corrupted by the earth elemental Princess Theradras.
Instances.name: Maraudon
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: A Defias prison on Alcaz Island that once held nobles for ransom, now besieged by the naga.
Instances.name: Alcaz Prison
Instances.statusText: Announced for launch. Bosses from the game; loot not revealed yet.

Instances.desc: The drowned Temple of Atal'Hakkar, where the Atal'ai trolls seek to summon the blood god Hakkar.
Instances.name: Sunken Temple
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The molten capital of the Dark Iron dwarves beneath Blackrock Mountain, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
Instances.name: Blackrock Depths
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The overgrown eastern gardens of Eldre'Thalas, where Alzzin the Wildshaper corrupts the ancient warpwood.
Instances.name: Dire Maul: East
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The lower halls of Blackrock Spire, a fortress of orcs and ogres under Overlord Wyrmthalak. Ten players in Forever.
Instances.name: Lower Blackrock Spire
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: A great furbolg city in northern Azshara fighting its own corruption. Its tunnels reach deep toward the Barrow Deeps.
Instances.name: Blackmaw Hold
Instances.statusText: Announced for launch. Bosses and loot not revealed yet.

Instances.desc: The Highborne of Eldre'Thalas drain the demon Immol'thar in the western wing, under Prince Tortheldrin.
Instances.name: Dire Maul: West
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The Gordok ogres have claimed the northern courts of Eldre'Thalas. Defeat King Gordok and claim their tribute.
Instances.name: Dire Maul: North
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The Cult of the Damned's school of necromancy in the crypts beneath Caer Darrow, led by Darkmaster Gandling.
Instances.name: Scholomance
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: The Scarlet Crusade holds the burning streets behind Stratholme's Main Gate against the Scourge.
Instances.name: Stratholme: Main Gate
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: Baron Rivendare rules the Scourge-held half of Stratholme from behind the Service Gate.
Instances.name: Stratholme: Service Gate
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: An untouched Titan facility in the hills of Un'Goro Crater, humming with power crystals and an energy no one can explain.
Instances.name: Shaper's Terrace
Instances.statusText: Announced for launch. Bosses from the game; loot not revealed yet.

Instances.desc: The upper spire of Blackrock, where Rend Blackhand and General Drakkisath command the Black Dragonflight's forces. Ten players in Forever.
Instances.name: Upper Blackrock Spire
Instances.statusText: Classic loot table; not playable in the beta yet. Forever changes will be added.

Instances.desc: Deathwing's daughter Onyxia waits in her lair in Dustwallow Marsh. Unlocks with the first Forever raid tier.
Instances.name: Onyxia's Lair
Instances.statusText: Forever loot not revealed yet. Showing the Classic loot table for reference.

Instances.desc: A vast network of night elven barrow dens that holds the world's most dangerous prisoners, and corruption is spreading.
Instances.name: Barrow Deeps
Instances.statusText: Forever raid (10 players). Bosses from the game; loot not revealed yet.

Instances.desc: Something is draining power from the land around Mount Hyjal, where ghosts of the Third War still walk.
Instances.name: Hyjal Summit
Instances.statusText: Forever raid (20 players). Bosses from the game; loot not revealed yet.
